title: Site B, Khayelitsha (area only, approx.): 2 men, 36 and 39, shot dead, 6 Oct
summary: Khayelitsha police registered two counts of murder after two men aged 36 and 39 were shot dead at about 04:30 on Tuesday 6 October in Masikhanye, Site B; no arrests were made (City Vision, quoting police spokesperson Wes...
story: Khayelitsha police registered two counts of murder after two men aged 36 and 39 were shot dead at about 04:30 on Tuesday 6 October in Masikhanye, Site B; no arrests were made (City Vision, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg).
location_note: Masikhanye, Site B, Khayelitsha. Masikhanye could not be found on the map, so the pin is a general Site B point, not the scene.

provenance.note: One report. Police statement plus community member Phiwe; separate first-hand corroboration is not established.

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS
sources.quote: where two males aged 36 and 39 were shot and fatally wounded.

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS
sources.quote: following a shooting on Tuesday morning, 6 October, at about 04:30 in Masikhanye, Site B
